newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA OPTIMISTIC RONALDO WILL STAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA OPTIMISTIC RONALDO WILL STAY.

text.p: Barcelona president Jose Luis Nunez said he was "fairly optimistic" that Brazilian striker Ronaldo would stay with the Spanish club.
Ronaldo, who has been linked to a number of Italian and English clubs, said last week that he would disclose his future plans this week.
Nunez, speaking to journalists following six-hour talks with Ronaldo's agents late on Monday, said the negotiations were 90 percent complete and would resume on Tuesday.
The 20-year-old striker has scored 34 goals this season putting him far ahead in both the Spanish goal scoring table and in the European leagues' Golden Boot competition.
